primary_semantic_reference.notes: StdGEN++ paper is methodology. Public StdGEN repo is not an asserted full ++ training builder.

count_unit: unique independently verified source identity cluster per head meeting all required CORE targets
golden_core_definition: Same unique FIT identity cluster qualifies all six head CORE groups with independent source, rights, split, and target receipts; additionally report graphics consequence and controller/deform advanced coverage. No assumption Core370 has full truth.
semantic_evidence_requirements: reviewed per-face or per-corner semantic concept with immutable source address and explicit unknown support
renderer source face-ID and camera/pose evidence for cross-view semantic map
source-name/artist-bone labels used only as privileged teacher hints, never student inputs
full/keep/hide/isolate observations and positive-negative edit consequence as separate Graphics/Compiler qualification
skin weight/mesh component cannot independently establish semantic identity
graphics_evidence_requirements: source_native_rgba and stylized_2d_rgba are distinct supervision types
independent stylized game-art visual review and source geometry/alpha/identity parity
realistic 3D source is not source-wide rejection; it may serve Geometry/TESSA/AXIS/MIRA independently

target_status_field_contract.source_cluster_id: stable verified lineage cluster ID; never filename or guessed visual match
target_status_field_contract.head: one of six heads
target_status_field_contract.historical_split: FIT, TUNE, DEV, CAL, EXTERNAL_HOLDOUT or QA
target_status_field_contract.model_consumer_contract_pass: boolean true for real matching head target/loss
target_status_field_contract.training_authorized: boolean true only after separate admission; coverage audit NEVER grants it

goal_assumption: Anymate or comparably large separately licensed rights-cleared source pool added; this numerical target does not assert current data sufficiency
activation_rule: 8K strategic goal applies as Anymate or equivalent large evidence-qualified pool enters source-level inventory; no forced admission of any asset to meet a numeric goal

limitations: 230716 asset entries not certified independent lawful RealSaS character identities
dataset repository Apache-2.0 card does not replace underlying source-asset rights verification
processed point/voxel/rig targets do not certify original scene/material/texture/camera/2D graphics
no native IK controls or reviewed semantic source-face labels guaranteed
source quality/character-vs-prop and morphology stratification required

head_specific_coverage_reporting.total_core_target_pass: All required core target and independent court receipts must PASS for that specific head
head_specific_coverage_reporting.advanced_targets: Report separately per head; never infer controls, 2D layers, mechanics from generic rig/skin
head_specific_coverage_reporting.morphology_buckets: Include humanoid, quadruped, winged, serpentine, multi-legged, armored/hard-surface, modular/attachment, other and unknown
head_specific_coverage_reporting.style_buckets: Native 2D, verified stylized derived 2D, non-stylized/realistic 3D, unknown; style cannot reject valid mechanical targets
head_specific_coverage_reporting.evidence_per_target: Source SHA, cluster/split, rights, target-specific source truth and independent court
